Romero (the real genius of the duo IMHO) went on to make his own movies which still define the entire genre. His films use the moniker "..of the dead" as opposed to "...living dead". You'd be hard pressed to find a modern zombie story that isn't heavily influenced by Romero's universe.

Of course you're going to make more money by changing employers if you're​ a kid with a starter job, because you're not expected to work those jobs forever. Walmart isn't going to pay programmer wages to a cashier who can program, so once you learn how to program, you get a new job and employer.
